scope: All selected trained model components reachable from the deployed Burmese Neural Reader WSGI application, checked through source loading paths and deployed artifact fingerprints

components.tok2vec: Joint shared learned encoder, evaluated through the downstream POS and dependency/sentence tasks; no separate standalone accuracy metric
components.morphologizer: 14 universal POS labels only; saved POS accuracy reproduced exactly
components.parser: Dependency and sentence-boundary predictions; saved UAS, LAS, sentence precision/recall/F1 and per-relation results retained

stock_stanza_components.role: Internal spans for Stanza NER; final reader words are selected by dictionary/unigram/bigram segmentation

additional_selected_assets: The reader's dictionary, myWord unigram/bigram frequency resources and lexical POS priors support segmentation and OCR-damage handling; they are not additional separately trained neural or CRF classifiers.

production_recheck.method: Read-only AST traversal of local imports reachable from wsgi.py; text scan for model loads, CRF/BILU and serialization APIs; known optional artifact existence checks
production_recheck.diagnostic_override: Existing diagnostic routes allow a caller-specified spaCy model path; this is not a separately selected application checkpoint.

coverage_verdict: All selected personally trained neural components are covered by the joint spaCy model's retained and exactly reproduced development results; no selected custom CRF/BILU model is missing from this inventory.
